reasons: comparator-promise-table-replace: The JMS comparator remains an informing result, but its match must record that the present Gaussian-coordinate theorem uses it only through the explicitly compatible embedded fuzzy support.

narrow: The original universal fixed-fit claim can fail when the Gaussian lower subexperiment is empty or when the particular cited fuzzy support cannot be embedded within the primitive envelope and the supplied-fit radii. The proposed statement adds only the exact nonemptiness and support-embedding compatibility conditions used by the two lower experiments, plus the cited theorem's product regime. It removes the earlier global sup-norm restrictions on the supplied fits and the unnecessary requirement that the sum of nuisance radii vanish. The cited source is invoked with supplied outcome fit \(\widehat q/A\) and outcome radius \(\varepsilon_{q,n}/(KA)\) before the outcome pushforward by \(A\).
